run_coverage_collection: run the cov script to collect gcda coverage data from boost histogram test directories
generate_html_coverage_report: run the cov script without arguments to generate an HTML coverage report in coverage-report directory
upload_coverage_to_coveralls: run the cov script with a coveralls token argument to upload coverage data to cpp-coveralls
download_lcov_tool: run the cov script which automatically downloads and extracts lcov 1.16 if not present in tools directory
extract_boost_histogram_coverage: run the cov script to extract only boost histogram coverage entries from the full coverage info file
